_comment: Bar-line edit of the raw v2 take onto the v2 timeline. Specific to v2 take 2 (music_v1, seed 777); a new take needs a new edit list. Times are on the musical grid; beatOffset (measured) is added to every time. Raw take analysis (tools/audio/work/music/v2/score.music_v1.seed777.raw.mp3): 120.000 BPM, beats at 0.025 + k/2 (high-band onsets on every beat). 0-8 hits; 8-30 bright groove; 30-32 break (= the S04 cut); 32-46 groove; 46-48 break; 48-60 groove; 60-64 dark turn (bass out, C# minor); 64-76 dark drone; 76-80 dip and short rise; DROP at 80; driving groove 80-122 (fills at 87.5, 95.5, 103.5, 111.5, 119.5); drumless outro 122-132 that stops dead at 132.0. Everything from the 46-48 break to the drop sits 4 s late, so the edit removes 2 bars before the break and repeats 2 groove bars before S08, which keeps the outro on 122.
_tempo: The raw take is exactly 120.000 BPM: its strong kick/snare transients sit on 0.02 + k/2 s from 2 s to 121.5 s. (beats.mjs mis-fit it as 120.33 BPM and band-onset folds as 119.73 BPM because of the 12 s drumless drone; an early version of this edit wrongly resampled it.) No tempo correction is applied.

segments.why: S01 hits, W1-S04 groove (the 30-32 break lands on the S04 cut)
skip 2 bars so the 46-48 break becomes the S02 -> U1 transition (42-44)
U1 groove, S05 dark turn on 56, drone, S06 rise, DROP on 76 (S07 start)
repeat those 2 bars under the S08 lift, then the fill at 119.5 and the outro on 122

gain.why: the drone falls away under the sub hit
S05 near silence after the subHit, through the start of S06 (the sub hit itself is added after the gain)
the raw outro stops dead at 132.0: fade it out instead

sweeps.why: S08 lift: groove thins out, snaps back full on the stitch hit

subHits.why: S05: one deep sub hit as everything falls away (subHit)

cues.what: bright groove, brightens from 16; 2-bar breaks at 30-32 (S04 cut) and 42-44 (into U1)
groove after the break (the take's chorus position)
dark turn on 56 (bass out, C# minor), dark drone 60-68, deep sub hit on 68 then near silence
near silence, short rise in the last second (the scene's riser SFX carries it)
stitch hit on 118: full groove back + sub hit; fill at 119.5
